- sp:sdk@1 的 kit 里同名的 helper 当成 Forge tier1 的同一个；SDK 的记录类 helper 返回冻结的副本，往里写的 kit 运行时才会出错。 (A helper of the SDK's kit with a Forge tier1 name is taken as the same helper; the SDK's record helpers return frozen copies, so a kit that writes into one fails when it runs.)

- sp:sdk@1 的 kit 里同名的 helper 当成 Forge tier1 的同一个；SDK 的记录类 helper 返回冻结的副本，往里写的 kit 运行时才会出错。 (A helper of the SDK's kit with a Forge tier1 name is taken as the same helper; the SDK's record helpers return frozen copies, so a kit that writes into one fails when it runs.)

- Forge 的 voices 是默认配音，文档写的是日文，所以写入 audio.voiceJp。 (Forge voices are the default dub, documented as Japanese, so they were written to audio.voiceJp.)
